summary: Frontend-only test of PropertyWorkspace (Ventas) 5-tab refactor. All 5 tabs render in the correct order (Datos, Fotos, Propietario y Documentos, Comercialización, Publicaciones y Gestión) with the correct data-testids (ws-tab-datos, ws-tab-fotos, ws-tab-propietario, ws-tab-comercializacion, ws-tab-publicaciones). Default active tab is 'Datos'. Panels switch correctly per tab (Datos → information+features+amenities; Fotos → photos; Propietario → owner+documents+documentacion; Comercialización → commercialization; Publicaciones → channels+stats). Header (title, status-bar, progress, Guardar) stays visible across all 5 tabs on an existing property. On new-property (/propiedades/nueva) route the tabs render and switch fine, and documentacion + stats are intentionally hidden (they require a saved property) — status-bar is also hidden on /nueva by design (isNew guard).
critical_code_review_comments: PropertyWorkspace.tsx is 694 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting tab panels into subcomponents (DatosTab, FotosTab, etc.) for maintainability.

Tabs currently only unmount+remount their content (no lazy load / no state preservation between tabs). Acceptable for now, but if inner sections use uncontrolled inputs, switching tabs could lose unsaved local state — verify with main agent whether all sections rely on the parent form context.
